name: mosfet_switch_on
description: Low-side NMOS switch turned ON (V_GATE=3V > V_TH=1.5V). Drain should be pulled close to GND — well below VIN/2.

DRAIN.rationale: With V_GS=3V, V_TH=1.5V, KP=100µA/V², W/L=1000, R_DS(on) ≈ 6Ω. Drain sits at VIN × R_DS(on)/(R_DS(on)+R1) = 5 × 6/10006 ≈ 3mV. Tolerance 0.1V accommodates model variability.
